jobs.description:
ADP is hiring a Project Manager – Learning.

Are you an experienced Project Manager who enjoys bringing structure to complex work and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that make a difference?
Are you motivated by supporting initiatives that drive business outcomes and help associates grow and succeed?
Do you thrive in dynamic environments where you can influence stakeholders, manage change, and drive projects to successful outcomes?

Well, this may be the role for you. Ready to make your mark?

In this role, you will support the delivery of enterprise learning initiatives, helping ensure project objectives, timelines, and success measures are achieved. You will develop and maintain project plans, manage risks and dependencies, facilitate project meetings, and provide visibility into project progress and outcomes. Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders and project teams, you will drive alignment, remove barriers, and ensure successful execution of key business initiatives.

To thrive in this role, you will bring enterprise-level project management experience leading cross-functional projects and partnering with stakeholders across multiple functions and levels of an organization. You will be comfortable working within established processes and tools with a willingness to learn new methodologies. You have a strong interest in learning and development and how training impacts business outcomes. You are highly organized, communicate effectively, and can balance multiple priorities while keeping projects moving forward. You are skilled at building partnerships, facilitating discussions, driving accountability, and navigating change.

Like what you see? Apply now!

Learn More About ADP At Jobs.adp.com

What you’ll do:

Deliver Project Management Services

Support the delivery of enterprise learning projects, helping ensure timelines, deliverables, and success measures are met
Create and maintain comprehensive project plans tracking milestones, tasks, and dependencies
Monitor project progress, identify risks or issues, and support the development of mitigation plans
Use project management tools to track performance, update status, and maintain visibility into project health
Prepare status reports by gathering, analyzing, and summarizing key project information
Work within established processes, templates, and governance standards to ensure consistency and quality

Lead Project Teams

Lead the project team from initial project identification through project closure
Create a team environment that promotes accountability and collaboration
Facilitate project status meetings, capturing updates, action items, and next steps
Act as a point of escalation for team members
Help ensure the quality of project team deliverables

Partner with Stakeholders

Maintain strong stakeholder engagement by supporting consistent communication throughout the project lifecycle
Actively listen to stakeholder needs and translate feedback into actions
Obtain approvals on project change requests ensuring the impacts are understood
Capture lessons learned and complete project closure activities

Experience.
You have 3-5+ years of experience in relevant skills gained and developed in the same or similar role.

To Succeed In This Role

Experience managing enterprise-level projects from initiation through closure, including planning, execution, risk management, resource coordination, stakeholder communications, and project delivery.
Experience partnering with and influencing cross-functional business stakeholders across multiple functions and levels of the organization to drive project outcomes.
Experience managing multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong communication, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
Strong organizational, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
Experience using project management tools such as Planview or Smartsheet, to plan, manage, and track project work.
PMP certification or must be obtained within 12 months of hire.
Curiosity and willingness to leverage AI tools and emerging technologies to improve productivity and project outcomes.
Experience with Microsoft Office Suite, including PowerPoint and Excel.
You'll have a Bachelor's degree OR equivalent experience.

For Additional Comfortability In The Role

Experience managing programs consisting of multiple related projects or workstreams.
Experience supporting learning, talent, human resources, organizational development, change management, or business transformation initiatives.
Experience supporting projects or geographically dispersed stakeholder groups.
CAPM, Change Management, or equivalent professional certification.

Collaboration. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and respect one another's ideas to find the best solution.

Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
Act like an owner & doer. Mission-driven and committed to navigating change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Quality Remediation Programs
jobs.description:
Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world. A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.

Position Summary

The Project Manager – Quality Remediation Programs is responsible for leading complex, cross-functional remediation initiatives to address quality system gaps, regulatory findings, and operational risks. This role drives execution of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), ensures compliance with applicable standards (e.g., ISO 13485, FDA, GMP), and restores sustainable quality system performance.

The role requires strong program governance, stakeholder alignment, and the ability to operate under high-pressure, high-visibility conditions (e.g., audit observations, warning letters, or compliance commitments).

Key Responsibilities

Experience driving alignment across engineering, operations and geographically distributed teams.

jobs.title: Regional Security Operations Manager - CTJ - Poly
jobs.description:
Overview

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day and we need you as a Regional Security Operations Manager.

As a Regional Security Operations Manager in CO+I Physical Security, you will be part of a global team dedicated to delivering the most trustworthy security program to protect the personnel, infrastructure, data, and confidential information foundational to the Microsoft Cloud. You will be accountable for physical security operations at datacenters and other related facilities within the applicable region and will manage in-region Datacenter Security Operations Managers who are responsible for security operations in their respective metros. You will lead teams in collaborating with stakeholders to meet collective security requirements and provide security capabilities, anticipate specific insecurity and security disruption (e.g., life safety, business operations, reputation) and lead discussions on developing strategies for mitigating risks and responding to residual risks. You will communicate risk analysis findings and root cause analysis reports to internal and external stakeholders and leaders. This opportunity will allow you to accelerate your career growth, develop deeper physical security acumen and global security program management. The Regional Security Operations Manager must be located in the applicable region and there is a flexible work opportunity to work from home partially or fully.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a Regional Security Operations Manager you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Do you want to empower billions across the world? Come and join us in CO+I and be at the forefront of the action!

Responsibilities

Security Program Management

Oversee and ensure the quality and high-performance delivery of one of the largest contract/vendor security guarding programs in the industry. Continuously assess and scorecard the vendors’ performance and staffing levels, manage budget and forecasting, recommend changes to reduce costs and optimize, ensure workplace health and safety programs are in place and running well, etc.
Develop, manage, and maintain physical security Standard Operations Procedures (SOP), and continuously improve the efficiency and maturity of the overall physical security program.
Provide situational awareness and analysis of the region’s security environment.

Security Leadership

Attract, develop and retain talent; deliver results through teamwork and effectively manage a team, where members are located in datacenter throughout multiple countries within the region.
Provides guidance to teams to design, implement, and monitor security controls to treat risks to infrastructure, business, people, and assets and then monitor the effectiveness of measures taken to modify risks.
On-call 24x7x365 and travel periodically as planned or unplanned within or outside of assigned region.
Receive escalations/notifications of physical security and business impacting incidents/events and appropriately triage and assess, ensuring that leadership is made initially and continuously aware when appropriate, and that the appropriate personnel are managing the incident response effectively.

Other

Embody our culture and values.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

6+ years experience in security program or program management or related field
OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements

Security Clearance Requirements:
Candidates must be able to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

The successful candidate must have an active U.S. Government Top Secret Clearance with access to Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) based on a Single Scope Background Investigation (SSBI) with Polygraph. Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required pre-offer and post-hire for this role. Failure to maintain or obtain the appropriate U.S. Government clearance and/or customer screening requirements may result in employment action up to and including termination.
Clearance Verification: This position requires successful verification of the stated security clearance to meet federal government customer requirements. You will be asked to provide clearance verification information prior to an offer of employment.
Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Citizenship & Citizenship Verification:
 This position requires verification of U.S. citizenship due to citizenship-based legal restrictions. Specifically, this position supports United States federal, state, and/or local United States government agency customer and is subject to certain citizenship-based restrictions where required or permitted by applicable law. To meet this legal requirement, citizenship will be verified via a valid passport, or other approved documents, or verified US government Clearance .

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Business Risks, or related field AND 12+ years experience in Security Program or Program Management
OR equivalent experience.

4+ years people management experience
Industry security certifications such as CPP, PSP, or other relevant security certification
Experience with or exposure to regulatory and industry compliance frameworks and audits (e.g. ISO27001, SOC, PCI)
Experience with government regulations on secure builds

Security M5 - The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $116,900 - $203,600 per year. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $148,400 - $222,600 per year.

Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. Find additional benefits and pay information here:

https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/us-corporate-pay

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Experiencia coordinando o liderando equipos de consultoría tecnológica.

Conocimientos técnicos generales en infraestructura de red, cortafuegos y herramientas de supervisión/vigilancia de seguridad.

jobs.title: Certification Project Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

SUSE is a global leader of enterprise open source software. By transforming community innovations into secure, sovereign and AI-ready solutions, SUSE empowers customers to escape vendor lock-in and regain control of their IT destiny. Through industry-leading Linux, Kubernetes, Edge and AI infrastructure solutions, SUSE delivers the flexibility to innovate everywhere—from the data center to multi-cloud and out to the edge. Only SUSE also manages many Linux and Kubernetes distributions. At SUSE, Choice Happens because we prioritize community, interoperability and relentless innovation. Discover how we power mission-critical resilience at www.suse.com.

Certification Project Manager

Job Description

Leading end-to-end security certification projects, ensuring our enterprise portfolio maintains high-assurance compliance. Driving precise delivery milestones, mitigate project risks, and align complex software architectures with strict evaluation criteria by leveraging deep domain expertise in cloud-native virtualization, KVM-based hypervisors, and containerized hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI).

Responsibilities

End-to-End Certification Ownership: Drive complex certification cycles (e.g., Common Criteria, FIPS) from initiation to completion for enterprise products, ensuring adherence to scope, schedule, and quality while leveraging AI-enabled project practices.
Milestone & Requirement Integration: Translate security functional/assurance requirements (SFRs/SARs) into actionable engineering milestones and rigorously track their progress.
Authority & Lab Interface: Act as the primary interface for evaluation labs (ITSEFs) and international certification bodies (e.g., BSI, NIAP, ANSSI), managing application paperwork and technical inquiries.
Cross-Functional Coordination: Liaise across Engineering, PM, external consultants, and partners to align compliance requirements and manage project expectations.
Secure Environment Rigor: Manage projects handling sensitive security data, proprietary information, and maintaining meticulous, audit-ready cycle documentation.
Knowledge Enablement: Organize targeted events, workshops, and enablement sessions to foster internal security awareness and share compliance standards.

Candidate Profile

Experience: 5+ years in the software product development industry or enterprise IT infrastructure.
Domain Expertise: Minimum 1-2 years managing product security compliance, with a primary focus on Common Criteria (specifically NIAP VPP or GPOS), alongside NIST/FIPS or ISO standards.
Virtualization & Cloud-Native Expertise: Technical familiarity with Linux operating systems, hypervisor technology stacks (e.g., KVM), containerized virtualization, hyperconverged architecture, and a strong understanding of their security boundaries.
Project Execution: Strong track record of milestone execution and data-driven prioritization using standard tracking tools (Jira, Confluence, MS Project) and AI-assisted productivity workflows.
Soft Skills & Communication: Outstanding diplomatic and negotiation skills for managing complex relationships with external labs and internal teams. Fluent, professional command of spoken and written English (German, Spanish, or Italian is a plus).
Credentials: Recognized project management qualification (e.g., PMP, or GPM/IPMA level C/D).

This position is subject to a background check(s), including criminal, credit, and/or employment references. The candidate is required to complete the background check(s) once an offer has been accepted. This will be conducted by SUSE’s external provider, where legally permitted.

As part of our commitment to pay transparency, we are sharing the expected total salary range associated with this role. This range includes the base salary and any applicable target bonus opportunity, subject to the terms of the relevant compensation plans and company policies. Please note that the salary range provided is intended only as a guideline. Individual offers may vary based on objective, non-discriminatory factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, internal equity, and budget considerations. In addition to competitive compensation, we are proud to offer an attractive benefits package. Pay Range for Italy: €54,000.00 - €77,000.00

jobs.title: Customer Implementation Manager, Buenos Aires
jobs.location: Buenos Aires, Buenos Aires Province, Argentina
jobs.description:
We believe conversations will become the #1 way to shop.

At Gorgias, we’re building the platform that makes this real: a unified AI agent that sells, supports, and re-engages customers across the entire journey. Conversational Commerce is the future of ecommerce, and we’re leading that shift.

Our mission is to turn every interaction between a brand and its customers into a relationship: personal, seamless, and intelligent. By combining deep product expertise with the latest in AI, we’re making shopping feel more natural, human, and connected than ever before.

To win, we focus relentlessly on:

Quality: conversations that feel authentic and on-brand.
Experience: effortless shopping from chat to checkout.
Re-engagement: personal, 1-1 dialogue instead of noisy marketing.

The opportunity is massive. As AI reshapes how people buy, Gorgias is building the foundation for the next decade of ecommerce, where every brand has its own intelligent agent and every customer feels understood.

Join us to make Conversational Commerce real.

About The Team

The Customer Implementation Team at Gorgias is dedicated to ensuring a seamless and successful start for every customer's journey with our products. Our primary objective is to elevate the onboarding experience by delivering a white-glove service and expert guidance to our customers. This involves cultivating a heightened proficiency in product knowledge, engaging in consultative conversations, and adopting a strategic implementation approach that extends beyond mere activation. Our mission is to empower companies to launch swiftly and effectively on Gorgias, showcasing the exceptional value of our flagship products: Helpdesk and AI Agent.

Our team plays a pivotal role in the overall success of our products, influencing customer adoption, usage, and retention. As AI becomes central to how merchants support their customers, we're at the forefront of helping businesses unlock automation, configure AI Agent, and drive measurable outcomes from day one. By fostering meaningful connections with our customers, we contribute to the sustained growth and satisfaction of businesses leveraging Gorgias solutions.

About The Role

As the Customer Implementation Manager, your role is to manage the entire onboarding process for your book of business, beginning to end - from sales handover through configuration, training, and activation. As the first point of contact, this role is instrumental in managing all aspects of customer relations post-sales stage.

You will actively contribute to our mission of providing a white-glove onboarding experience, showcasing the value of our flagship products, Helpdesk and AI Agent. The perfect fit for this role is an adept professional with a consultative mindset and a strategic approach to onboarding.

What You’ll Do

Conduct in-depth implementation and optimization sessions for new and cross sold customers, tailoring the experience to drive adoption and usage of our Helpdesk and AI Agent products.
Build on behalf of the customer, utilizing a consultative approach to customize solutions that align with their specific needs and goals.
Drive the activation ratio and reduce time to activation through a white-glove experience, providing guidance and onboarding for Helpdesk and AI Agent products.
Establish trust with customers by demonstrating expert knowledge of our products, sharing best practices, and driving value-driven adoption to achieve key business results.
Act as the primary liaison between customers and internal teams, ensuring seamless communication and support throughout the onboarding process.
Document customer interactions and feedback meticulously, leveraging this data to continuously improve the onboarding and overall customer experience.
Analyze and interpret e-commerce customer data, providing valuable insights to optimize support strategies using the AI Agent product.
Drive project timelines through clear milestone setting with the customer, ensuring effective project management throughout the onboarding process.
Proactively identify and mitigate potential roadblocks to decrease time to value, assisting companies in launching quickly and effectively on Gorgias.

Who You Are

Experience: 2-3+ years in SaaS as an implementation manager driving post-sales adoption and activation, demonstrating a successful track record. E-commerce experience is a plus!
Consultancy and Project Management: 2-3+ years of experience crafting and overseeing project timelines tailored to enhance activation among merchants, encompassing strategic recommendations and actionable suggestions.
Communication Skills: Excellent communication, interpersonal, follow-up, and attention to detail skills.
Proactive Work Approach: Proficient in concurrently managing up to 30 accounts at a given time, adept at tailoring support to meet the diverse needs of both small and large merchants. You are a self-starter; you will be provided with a lot of autonomy in this role.
Adaptability and Learning Agility: Thrives in an evolving onboarding process, demonstrating adaptability to change, quick learning, and the ability to keep up with new product developments and process changes.
Relationship Building: Passionate about building and maintaining relationships, with a focus on driving engagement, product adoption and mitigating churn.
Passion for Learning: Demonstrated passion for continuous learning and personal growth.
AI & Automation Mindset: Passionate about technology, automation, and the future of AI in customer support. Comfortable configuring AI tools, discussing automation strategy with merchants, and learning new AI capabilities quickly.

AI at Gorgias

At Gorgias, AI is a natural extension of how we work and build. Our teams use it every day to research, write, analyze, code, and craft better customer experiences. Everyone has access to premium AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Granola & others) and an annual L&D budget to explore new ones.

The real magic happens when we share what we learn. Our #powerup Slack channel is a digital petri dish of new tools and workflows, and each team has AI champions who showcase fresh ideas during weekly company-wide standups, now practically AI demo sessions.

We see AI not as a replacement for creativity or empathy, but as a multiplier, helping us move faster, think deeper, and serve customers better.

AI use in Recruiting at Gorgias

By submitting your application, you agree that Gorgias may collect and process your personal data for recruiting, workforce planning, and related purposes. For more information about how we process your data and your rights, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Policy.

Diversity & Inclusion at Gorgias

We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives because diverse teams drive innovation and better decision-making.

If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, please contact us at accommodation@gorgias.com.

jobs.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team

Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers.

The Role:

As a Lead Project Manager
, you will support end-to-end implementations of Celonis’ technology across our largest and most strategic customers. You will articulate Celonis’ product positioning to customers and collaborate with Sales, Partners and Value Engineering to establish Celonis’ Services Value proposition and create statements of work with customers during the pre-sales phase.

In this role, you will assist customers in understanding how to build best practice and enduring capabilities, are responsible for identifying further Services needs by the customer whilst engaged and responsible for customer satisfaction throughout a customer's engagement with Celonis.

Fluency in German language is required.

The work you’ll do:

Lead complex transformational customer programs, shape and define the project outcome and then steer towards it.
Planning, scheduling, and management of project timelines and activities from project kick-off through to training, ensuring each project is delivered on time and meets the customers' requirements.
Manage resources, schedule, scope and budget on multiple projects by creating and maintaining detailed project plans that emphasize speed to delivery and maximise the efficient use of resources needed to meet the requirements.
Collaboration with senior executives, process owners and technical teams within each customer to understand their goals, objectives and requirements and to ensure their successful implementation. You will be their primary point of contact for product feature requests and escalation of support issues.
Regularly communicate project status, covering key discussion items, action items, risks and issues. Keep projects up to date in the Celonis Professional Services Automation System to enable accurate and timely project and portfolio reporting.
Proactively manage and escalate risks and issues internally to Celonis management and externally to customer project sponsors to minimize impact to project success.
Provide guidance and mentoring to the implementation team, including partner resources, to ensure Celonis methodology is being followed.
Use your experience to contribute to the continual improvement of Celonis Services methods as well as the maturing field expertise and best practices.

The qualifications you need:

Client-facing Project Management experience in enterprise software implementations, managing multiple projects concurrently.
Extensive experience in project management disciplines, including documenting and maintaining project plans, risk/issue/action logs, and driving problem resolution in partnership with customers and Celonis executives.
Strong communication skills and a background in consulting with a proven ability to manage stakeholders and project timelines.
Experience in people managing consulting teams both onshore and offshore.
Experience in positioning Services, writing proposals and “statement of works” within a complete ecosystem (customers and partners).
A history of working with an ecosystem of partners and managed co-delivery.
Ability to effectively set and manage customer expectations.
Strong analytical skills, especially in applying technology solutions to core business problems.
Ability and willingness to be certified in Celonis products.
Project management certifications (PMP, Prince2, or Safe/Agile).
Bachelors or Masters in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or other related field.

What Celonis can offer you:

Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.
Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. With more than 30 licensed and owned brands, including some of the most sought-after names in global fashion, our success is driven by our team’s entrepreneurial spirit and our deep relationships across the industry.

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Senior IT Project Manager
to join our Management Information Systems (MIS) team. This role will play a critical part in overseeing enterprise technology programs, strategic projects, M&A integration activities, and executive Steering Committees, with an initial focus on the technology integration and provide program management oversight of the G-III technology portfolio. The ideal candidate is an experienced project management professional who can balance tactical execution with strategic planning while driving complex global initiatives that align with company objectives and deliver measurable business value.

Key Responsibilities

Lead multiple concurrent enterprise technology programs and projects while ensuring alignment with business strategy and organizational priorities.
Manage the full project lifecycle, including planning, execution, governance, budgeting, resource allocation, risk management, and project closeout.
Coordinate cross-functional teams, business stakeholders, third-party vendors, and systems integrators to ensure successful project delivery.

Lead project issue resolution involving scope, timelines, resourcing, business functionality, technical challenges, and project risks.
Coordinate project priorities across business and technology teams to ensure alignment with enterprise deliverables.
Support and enhance Project Management methodologies while recommending best practices to improve governance, consistency, and delivery across the PMO.
Mentor project teams and promote consistent use of enterprise project management standards, documentation, and processes.
Lead enterprise technology initiatives spanning SaaS applications, infrastructure, cloud migration, cybersecurity, digital commerce, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, MuleSoft, OMS, PIM, DAM, APIs, ERP, POS, WMS, and related enterprise platforms.
Manage strategic technology vendors, contract transitions, Statements of Work (SOWs), and multi-vendor delivery teams.
Incorporate organizational change management, business readiness, knowledge transfer, cutover planning, adoption strategies, and hypercare into enterprise technology implementations.
Lead technology integration efforts for mergers and acquisitions, including TSA transitions, Day One readiness, operational separation, data migration, onboarding, stabilization, and vendor transitions.
Support Centers of Excellence and executive Steering Committees by providing portfolio reporting, financial updates, risk assessments, dependency management, executive decision support, and forward-looking technology roadmaps.
Own and maintain our technology portfolio, balancing integration initiatives, operational priorities, resource constraints, and business demand following transition into the G-III technology ecosystem.

Who You Are

A strategic project management professional with experience leading complex enterprise technology initiatives.
A collaborative partner who effectively works across executive leadership, business stakeholders, IT teams, and external vendors.
A proactive problem-solver who anticipates challenges and develops practical, scalable solutions.
A strong communicator who can translate complex technical initiatives into meaningful business outcomes.
A highly organized professional who thrives in a fast-paced, global, matrixed environment.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field preferred.
10+ years of PMO, program, or project management experience leading complex enterprise-level global technology initiatives.
Strong understanding of apparel industry business processes, including wholesale, retail, omnichannel commerce, supply chain, and order-to-cash operations.
Proven experience implementing and managing concurrent enterprise initiatives across multi-brand, multi-platform, and multi-region organizations.
Demonstrated experience managing ERP, OMS, digital commerce, cloud migration, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and M&A integration programs.
Experience managing Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365), Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC), MuleSoft, Shopify, OMS, PIM, DAM, payment platforms, customer identity platforms, APIs, middleware, and enterprise SaaS ecosystems preferred.
Strong knowledge of Project Management methodologies, SDLC, SOX governance, PCI compliance, and enterprise IT best practices.
Experience developing process flows, integration diagrams, and technical documentation using Visio or similar tools.
Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Jira, and related project management platforms.
Experience managing capital project budgets and executive portfolio reporting.
Experience utilizing AI-enabled project management and productivity tools to improve planning, documentation, reporting, meeting management, and risk identification.
PMP or equivalent Project Management certification preferred.
Willingness to travel as business needs require.

What We Offer

Competitive salary

Modern Technology Solutions, Inc. (MTSI) is searching for a Cybersecurity Systems Analyst - Senior
in support of United States Space Force (USSF) Space Systems Command (SSC) and Combat Forces Command (CFC) Defensive Cyber Operations.

A Cybersecurity Systems Analyst in this context is responsible for continuously assessing, monitoring, and reporting on the operational health, readiness, and effectiveness of Defensive Cyber Operations for Space (DCO-S) capabilities. This includes both internal (enterprise/home-station) systems and external (field/operational site) deployments.

The Cybersecurity Systems Analyst focuses on analyzing, assessing, and strengthening the security posture of information systems through continuous evaluation of cybersecurity controls, vulnerabilities, and risks. The Cybersecurity Systems Analyst supports the full system lifecycle by performing security assessments, implementing and validating technical controls, and ensuring compliance with federal cybersecurity standards (including NIST SP 800-53 and the Risk Management Framework). Has an in-depth understanding of cybersecurity policies, procedures, and technical architectures for government-sector information systems, with sufficient hands-on knowledge to implement and sustain them. Provides technical security guidance and analysis in collaboration with system owners, ISSOs, engineers, and stakeholders, while supporting secure system development, cloud environments, and operational needs. This position may require privileged access and DoD 8570/8140 restrictions will apply.

Role And Responsibilities

Internal DCO-S Capability Health Assessment
Continuously monitor the operational status, performance, and availability of enterprise DCO-S tools, sensors, platforms, and infrastructure.
Conduct regular health checks, configuration audits, and performance analysis on DCO-S systems to identify degradation, misconfigurations, or emerging issues.
Analyze system logs, metrics, and alerts to evaluate the overall cybersecurity posture and effectiveness of internal DCO-S capabilities.
Track and report on key health indicators (availability, latency, detection coverage, false-positive rates, patch compliance, etc.).
Support vulnerability scanning, STIG compliance validation, and remediation tracking for DCO-S systems hosted in enterprise environments.
Maintain accurate documentation of system baselines, configurations, and health trends for internal DCO-S assets.
External / Field / Operational Site DCO-S Health Assessment
Assess the operational health and readiness of DCO-S capabilities deployed at remote or operational sites (including deployable kits, forward-based systems, and site-specific installations).
Coordinate with field operators and site personnel to collect health status data, performance metrics, and issue reports from operational locations.
Perform or support remote and on-site evaluations of deployed DCO-S tools to verify functionality, connectivity, sensor coverage, and alignment with mission requirements.
Identify capability gaps, degraded performance, or sustainment issues affecting DCO-S systems in the field.
Support troubleshooting, configuration validation, and restoration of DCO-S capabilities at operational sites when issues are detected.
Track the status of deployable DCO-S systems (e.g., readiness of kits, software versions, hardware health) across multiple locations.
Analysis, Reporting & Continuous Improvement
Develop and maintain dashboards, status reports, and briefings on the overall health of DCO-S capabilities (internal + external).
Analyze trends and root causes of capability degradation; recommend corrective actions, process improvements, or technical mitigations.
Support risk assessments related to DCO-S system health that could impact mission readiness or defensive cyber operations.
Collaborate with system owners, ISSOs, engineers, and operational units to ensure DCO-S capabilities remain effective and mission-ready.
Assist in the validation of security controls and continuous monitoring activities specifically tied to DCO-S platforms.
Contribute to after-action reviews and lessons-learned processes following exercises, deployments, or real-world events involving DCO-S systems.
Coordination & Support
Serve as a technical point of contact for DCO-S health and readiness questions from leadership, operators, and supporting organizations.
Coordinate with external stakeholders (site teams, higher headquarters, vendors) to resolve health-related issues affecting operational DCO-S capabilities.
Support planning and execution of system upgrades, patches, and configuration changes while minimizing impact on operational availability.

Required

At least 12+ years' related professional experience
Experience analyzing system architectures, identifying security gaps, and recommending technical mitigations.
Familiarity with SIEM tools, log analysis, and basic threat detection/response activities.
Strong written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation, risk reporting, and stakeholder interaction.
Experience deploying, managing, or troubleshooting Docker containers
Familiarity with automation and configuration-management tools such as Ansible
Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python and Bash
Ability to work independently on assigned systems while collaborating effectively in cross-functional teams.
Knowledge of Defense-in-Depth architectures, network security principles, operating system hardening, and cloud security concepts.
Prior experience supporting federal, DoD, or intelligence community systems.
Strong understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and models, including MITRE ATT&CK and the Cyber Kill Chain

Desired

Experience integrating with enterprise DevSecOps platforms such as Platform One, Space CAMP, or other DoD enterprise PaaS environments.
Experience with GitLab, including source control and CI/CD workflows
Experience applying machine learning to cybersecurity or data-analysis use cases

Who We Are

At Corebridge Financial, we believe action is everything. That’s why every day we partner with financial professionals and institutions to make it possible for more people to take action in their financial lives, for today and tomorrow.

We Align To a Set Of Values That Are The Core Pillars That Define Our Culture And Help Bring Our Brand Purpose To Life

We are stronger as one: We collaborate across the enterprise, scale what works and act decisively for our customers and partners.
We deliver on commitments: We are accountable, empower each other and go above and beyond for our stakeholders.
We learn, improve and innovate: We get better each day by challenging the status quo and equipping ourselves for the future.
We are inclusive: We embrace different perspectives, enabling our colleagues to make an impact and bring their whole selves to work.

Who You’ll Work With

The Information Technology organization is the technological foundation of our business and works in collaboration with our partners from across the company. The team drives technology and digital transformation, partners with business leaders to design and execute new strategies through IT and operations services and ensures the necessary IT risk management and security measures are in place and aligned with enterprise architecture standards and principles.

About The Role

As a Senior Investigations Analyst
, you are the lead "digital detective" for the organization. You will be responsible for conducting complex, forensically sound investigations into security breaches, policy violations, and potential litigation matters. You will leverage advanced forensic suites—with a particular focus on Nuix—to parse massive datasets, recover "hidden" evidence, and build a factual narrative for legal, HR, and executive stakeholders.

Responsibilities

Forensic Acquisition & Preservation

Chain of Custody: Lead the collection and preservation of digital evidence (workstations, mobile, cloud, and server logs) ensuring strict adherence to forensic standards and chain-of-custody protocols.
Imaging & Extraction: Perform live and dead-box imaging of systems across diverse OS environments (Windows, macOS, Linux).
Remote Collections: Utilize enterprise forensic tools to perform stealthy, remote data acquisitions without disrupting business operations.

Deep-Dive Investigation & Analysis

Axiom/Nuix Power User: Utilize forensic toolsets to ingest, process, and analyze multi-terabyte datasets. You will be expected to create complex search queries, perform deduplication, and identify communication patterns across disparate data sources.
Artifact Analysis: Investigate system artifacts (e.g. Registry, MFT, Shellbags, LNK files) to reconstruct user activity and timeline events.
Data Recovery: Perform file carving and unallocated space analysis to recover deleted or obscured evidence.
Email & Communication Forensics: Conduct deep-dive analysis of PST/OST files and cloud-based mail (O365/Gmail) to identify evidence of data exfiltration or collusion.

Reporting & Stakeholder Management

Expert Reporting: Translate technical forensic findings into clear, "plain English" investigative reports suitable for legal proceedings or executive review.
Interdisciplinary Collaboration: Act as the technical liaison for Legal, HR, and Internal Audit teams to define the scope of investigations and provide status updates on high-sensitivity cases.
Continuous Improvement: Refine forensic workflows and laboratory standards to ensure the team stays ahead of anti-forensic techniques.

Skills And Qualifications

Technical Requirements

Experience: 4+ years of experience in digital forensics and/or corporate investigations.
Forensic Toolset Mastery:
Axiom or Nuix (Highly Preferred)
Other Tools: Advanced experience with at least two of the following: EnCase, FTK, Autopsy or X-Ways Forensics.
Mobile Forensics: Experience with Cellebrite UFED or Magnet GrayKey.
DLP: Purview

Technical Knowledge

Deep understanding of file systems (NTFS, APFS, Ext4), memory forensics (Volatility), and cloud-native logging (Azure Unified Audit Log, AWS CloudTrail).
Scripting (Plus): Basic ability to use Python or SQL to automate data parsing or query large investigative databases.
Preferred Certifications
Tool-Specific: Nuix Workstation Forensic Practitioner, EnCE, or MCFE.
Vendor-Neutral: GIAC Certified Forensic Analyst (GCFA), GIAC Network Forensic Analyst (GNFA), or Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE).

Soft Skills

Ethics & Integrity: Unwavering commitment to maintaining confidentiality and impartiality during sensitive investigations.
The "Detective Mindset": The ability to look past the obvious and connect non-linear data points to find the "smoking gun."
Clarity under Pressure: Experience delivering tough findings to senior leadership in high-stress environments.

Compensation

The anticipated salary range for this position is $128,000 to $140,000 at the commencement of employment for the Jersey City, NJ and Woodland Hills, CA area. Not all candidates will be eligible for the upper end of the salary range. The actual compensation offered will ultimately be dependent on multiple factors, which may include the candidate’s geographic location, skills, experience and other qualifications.

In addition, the position is eligible for a discretionary bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable incentive plan.

Corebridge also offers a range of competitive benefits as part of the total compensation package, as detailed below.

Work Location

This position is based in Corebridge Financial’s Woodland Hills, CA, Jersey City, NJ, or Houston, TX office and is subject to our hybrid working policy, which gives colleagues the benefits of working both in an office and remotely.

Estimated Travel

May include up to 25%.

Why Corebridge?

Central Maine Healthcare (CMH), a member of Prime Healthcare Foundation, is an integrated healthcare delivery system serving approximately 400,000 residents across central, western, and midcoast Maine through a network of more than 40 primary and specialty care locations. The system includes Central Maine Medical Center (CMMC) in Lewiston, a 250-bed, not-for-profit regional referral hospital that is home to the region's only Cancer Care Center, an orthopedic ambulatory surgery center, and the Central Maine Heart and Vascular Institute. CMH also includes Bridgton Hospital and Rumford Hospital, two 25-bed critical access hospitals that provide essential care to Maine's rural communities.

The manager will convene, coordinate, lead and align the system leaders in their responsibilities to identify patient safety risks and will support/facilitate the implementation of systems and processes that promote a culture of safety and reduce patient harm.

About Bolt

Bolt is shaping a future where cities are built for people, not cars. What started as an ambitious project of a 19-year-old in 2013 has grown into a global mobility platform used by more than 200 million customers and 4.5 million driver and courier partners across 50 countries.

From ride-hailing and food delivery to scooters, e-bikes, and car-sharing, Bolt helps people move through cities every day. Small, autonomous teams drive this work, combining the speed and ownership of a startup with the scale of a global technology company backed by more than €1bn in funding.

And we're just getting started.

Why join Bolt?

Build the future of mobility and help transform how people live and move in cities.
Tackle challenges at scale that span technology, operations, regulation, and growth.
Take real ownership early. Small, lean teams mean your decisions matter from day one, and you'll learn fast alongside some of the best people in the industry.
Join one of Europe's leading technology companies, backed by world-class investors including Sequoia.

About The Role

We're hiring a Senior Operations Specialist to drive performance across Bolt's rides marketplace in Poland. This isn't a typical Data Analyst role. Beyond strong analytical skills, we need someone excited to own operational projects end to end: analyzing our product, building deep dives for Bolt's leadership, and getting into the weeds of our financial processes to fix and improve them. It's a chance to build both analytical and business skills, positioning you to become a top business operator in the industry.

You'll dig deep into data, build the case for action, and own execution end to end. You don't just hand off insights, you fix the problem.

In this role you will lead high-stakes analytical and finance projects across supply, demand, pricing, and conversion, identify what's broken and why, and lead the operational interventions that move the numbers. Analysis is the starting point - impact is the goal. You'll partner closely with Finance, Growth, Marketing, and Product, manage relationships with our key Fleet Partners, and design the scalable processes that let the team keep compounding those gains.

Main Tasks And Responsibilities

Own end-to-end marketplace analysis: deep-dive data, build models, and develop dashboards across supply, demand, pricing, and marketplace health.
Diagnose performance issues and translate findings into clear actions, quantifying impact on rides, revenue, and cost.
Understand our financial processes, own them, and drive improvement.
Own execution - design and deliver operational interventions across pricing, incentives, driver engagement, and supply–demand balance.
Act as Account Manager for key Fleet Partners, helping them resolve issues, scale on Bolt, and align on shared performance goals.
Design, document, and improve scalable processes that the wider team can run with, and hold yourself accountable for measurable outcomes.

About You

3–5 years in operations, strategy, or analytical roles (marketplace, mobility, or tech preferred).
Exceptional data analysis and modelling skills - you independently build and interrogate datasets, structure complex problems, and translate findings into action.
Advanced Excel / Google Sheets modelling (forecasting, scenarios, unit economics) and hands-on experience with BI tools (Looker, Power BI, or similar). SQL is a strong plus.
Process-minded and self-sufficient - you design new ways of working rather than just operate within existing ones, and thrive in fast-paced environments with minimal supervision.
Clear, concise communicator in English and Polish, able to influence senior stakeholders and manage external partners with confidence.
Nice to have: fluency with AI tools to accelerate your work - using AI to analyse data, prototype models, and design or document new processes faster than the next person.

Why you’ll love it here

Accelerate your professional growth with unique career opportunities.
Enjoy a rewarding salary and stock options, knowing that as Bolt succeeds, so do you.
Take care of your physical and mental health with our wellness perks.
Celebrate 5 years at Bolt with a 1-month paid sabbatical to recharge.
Connect with colleagues at annual company events and smaller team gatherings.
Balance flexibility and in-person collaboration with our hybrid model, including at least 12 monthly in-office days.

Some perks may differ depending on your location and role.

At Bolt, using AI daily is a baseline expectation for everyone. If there’s a faster, smarter way to do your work, we expect you to find it. You’re still responsible for the output, so the standard stays high when using AI tools.

Experience is great, but what we really look for is drive, intelligence, and integrity. So even if you don’t tick every box, please consider applying!

Everyone is welcome

Job Description

The role

The Trading Operations Analyst is the production layer of the trade operations function — responsible for the accurate and timely completion of all post-trade activity across every asset class the desk trades. This includes equities, ETFs, fixed income, derivatives, FX, digital assets, and physical commodities.

This role is for someone who takes precision seriously, escalates early, and approaches their work with a process- improvement mindset. The desk is actively deploying AI tools to automate routine tasks — this person is expected to engage with those tools, validate their outputs, and help identify where they can do more. You do not need to build the tools; you need to use them well.

Securities setup is a meaningful and distinctive part of this role. Private placements, structured instruments, and alternative asset classes need to be correctly established in the book of record before they can trade — this person owns that process.

The Team

The Capital Markets & Trading team operates as a single unit across two functions: trading and trade operations. Both sides of the desk understand the full trade lifecycle — from execution through settlement — and cover each other when it counts. The expectation is not siloed expertise; it is shared ownership of outcomes. The Trading Operations Analyst works closely with the Senior Trading Operations Analyst, building deep knowledge of the post-trade function while developing a working understanding of the broader desk. This is a role with a clear path forward for the right person.

Ensure data integrity across all security records: positions, pricing, corporate actions, and reference data
Support the Senior Trading Operations Analyst in maintaining firm’s internal book of record

Contribute to workflow improvement — identify manual steps that can be automated and work with the Senior Trading Operations Analyst to build better processes

Corporate Actions & Proxy

Monitor and administer corporate actions across all fund holdings — elections, tracking, booking, and validation
Liaise with portfolio managers on elective corporate actions; administer proxy voting in accordance with fund policies

Experience

1–3 years of experience in trade settlement, operations, or fund administration at a bank, prime broker, custodian, or asset manager
Hands-on experience with trade matching and the settlement lifecycle
Experience performing cash and position reconciliations and resolving breaks

Strong understanding of UPI & IMPS transaction flows: payer/payee journeys, PSP/TPAP roles, NPCI switch behaviour, timeouts, declines, and chargebacks.

ISO 8583, ISO 20022 concepts, REST/JSON APIs, and NPCI message specifications.

Job Overview

BASIC SUMMARY:

Responsible for handling and processing samples and performing accurate data collection and reporting. Perform laboratory tasks by various moderately complex methods.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Effectively and efficiently perform and document all procedures, materials and results in compliance with all regulatory standards as applicable (GLPs, protocols, analytical procedures, SOPs, etc.).
Ability to effectively communicate with all applicable parties in formal/informal settings.

Assist with the preparation of study materials for routine production work with minimal oversight.
Capable of assisting with training of new staff members for most operational functions as needed.
Perform all other related duties as assigned.

Education: Bachelor’s degree (B.A. / B.S)
Experience: At least 1-year related experience.

Understanding of regulatory requirements of study types assigned, as well as Testing Facility SOPs and the Good Laboratory Practices (GLPs), as appropriate. Written and verbal communication skills. jobs.title: Program Manager, AI Transformation & Continuous Improvement, Vendor Operations
jobs.description:
Overview

Organization Summary

At Global Vendor Delivery & Solutions (GVDS), we are transforming how Microsoft delivers business operations at scale. As part of MBO (Microsoft Business Operations), GVDS combines operational excellence, AI-powered innovation, and strategic partnerships to create secure, scalable, and high-performing services across a global vendor ecosystem.

As Microsoft evolves toward a Frontier Firm model, AI, automation, and agentic systems are reshaping how work gets done. GVDS plays a critical role in enabling that transformation by helping operations become more intelligent, adaptive, and outcome-focused. We are looking for leaders who can challenge legacy approaches, accelerate adoption of AI-first ways of working, and build sustainable systems that continuously improve customer and business outcomes.

Role Summary

The AI Transformation & Continuous Improvement Lead is responsible for embedding a culture of continuous improvement across Vendor Operations while accelerating the adoption of AI-enabled operating models. This role serves as a strategic bridge between operations, engineering, service design, and vendor partners to identify opportunities for transformation, eliminate inefficiencies, and drive measurable business outcomes.

Success in this role requires equal parts transformational leadership, operational excellence, and change management. The ideal candidate will build scalable improvement systems, champion AI-driven innovation, and advance Vendor Operations toward a Frontier Firm model that delivers greater quality, productivity, customer satisfaction, and business value.

This is not a traditional Continuous Improvement role focused solely on Lean methodologies. It is a transformation leadership role responsible for helping redefine how operations are designed, executed, measured, and continuously optimized in an AI-first world.

Responsibilities

Capability Portfolio Ownership & Feature Management

Own the strategy, roadmap, prioritization, business cases, implementation governance, adoption, benefits realization, and continuous improvement of a portfolio of artificial intelligence-driven operational capabilities.
Maintain accountability beyond deployment to ensure capabilities continue to evolve and deliver measurable business outcomes.

AI Transformation & Frontier Firm Enablement

Lead the adoption of AI-first and agentic operating models across Vendor Operations.
Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve decision-making through AI-enabled workflows.
Partner with engineering, service design, and operations teams to scale AI and automation capabilities.
Drive operational readiness for Microsoft's Frontier Firm vision.

Continuous Improvement System Deployment

Establish and scale continuous improvement practices across Vendor Operations using Plan-Do-Check-Act (PDCA), Lean, or other structured problem-solving methodologies.
Build repeatable improvement frameworks that create sustainable operational gains.
Facilitate cross-functional improvement initiatives that drive measurable business impact.
Ensure improvements are standardized and institutionalized through governance and operational rhythms.

Operational Excellence & Performance Management

Define and track metrics that reflect customer value, operational efficiency, quality, productivity, and adoption of AI-enabled capabilities.
Develop performance insights that enable leaders to prioritize investments and improvement opportunities.
Create visibility into operational health and transformation progress through data-driven reporting.

Change Management & Organizational Adoption

Lead adoption strategies for new capabilities, operating models, tools, and ways of working, using stakeholder feedback and performance data to guide ongoing capability improvements.
Partner with stakeholders to remove barriers and accelerate behavioral change.
Ensure improvements transition from pilots to sustainable business practices.
Build organizational capability for continuous learning and improvement.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence

Serve as a trusted advisor to Vendor Operations leaders on transformation priorities and continuous improvement strategy.
Align stakeholders across Vendor Operations, Engineering, Service Design, and broader MBO initiatives.
Foster knowledge sharing and reuse of best practices across the vendor ecosystem.
Drive organizational alignment around operational excellence and business outcomes.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Business, Operations, Finance, or related field AND 4+ years experience in program management, process management, or process improvement OR equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

6+ years of experience leading operational transformation, continuous improvement, or business process optimization initiatives in complex global organizations.
Demonstrated success driving measurable improvements in quality, productivity, customer experience, or operational efficiency.
Strong data-driven decision-making skills with experience defining and managing operational performance metrics.
Proven ability to influence organizational boundaries and lead without direct authority. Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
Experience owning a portfolio of operational capabilities or features, including strategy, roadmap planning, prioritization, business case development, implementation governance, adoption, and benefits realization.
Experience deploying AI, automation, or agentic solutions within operational environments.
Experience implementing structured improvement methodologies such as Lean, PDCA, Kaizen, or related frameworks.
Knowledge of vendor operations, outsourcing models, or large-scale service delivery organizations.
Experience partnering with engineering, product, or service design teams on transformation initiatives.
Familiarity with Responsible AI principles and AI governance considerations.
Certification or experience in Lean Six Sigma or comparable continuous improvement disciplines.

Success Measures

Success In This Role Will Be Measured By

Adoption and scalability of continuous improvement practices across Vendor Operations.
Increased AI-enabled automation and reduction of manual effort.
Improvements in customer satisfaction, quality, productivity, and operational efficiency.
Demonstrated business impact from transformation initiatives.
Increased organizational capability and adoption of AI-first ways of working.
Establishment of sustainable operational excellence and governance practices.
Contribution toward the evolution of Vendor Operations into a Frontier Firm operating model.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Infrastructure Program Manager, AWS DC Acqn&Construction
jobs.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of technical program managers, design engineers, construction managers, network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The ML Capacity Delivery Team (MLZ) is seeking a Principal Technical Infrastructure Program Manager to define and drive the technical vision, strategy, and roadmap for the systems and tools that enable ML capacity delivery at global scale. In this role, you will serve as the single-threaded technical leader responsible for building, evolving, and scaling the platforms and automation that underpin how we plan, track, and deliver ML infrastructure; from demand signal through rack-level installation.

You will work at the intersection of infrastructure delivery, data engineering, and tooling while partnering with systems engineers, software development teams, Business Intelligence Engineers (BIE), operations leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate complex operational requirements into scalable, reliable systems. The ideal candidate is a seasoned technical leader who thrives in ambiguity, can articulate a compelling 1–3 year technical roadmap, and has a track record of driving cross-organizational alignment to deliver platforms that fundamentally improve how teams operate at scale.

Key job responsibilities

Own the technical vision and multi-year roadmap (1–3 years) for ML Capacity Delivery systems and tools, aligning investments to business priorities and capacity delivery goals across core and Gen AI platforms.
Drive cross-functional alignment across systems engineering, software development, BIE, operations, and planning teams to define requirements, prioritize capabilities, and deliver integrated tooling solutions.
Architect and deliver scalable platforms that automate and optimize capacity delivery workflows; including demand planning, build tracking, supply chain visibility, and operational reporting.
Serve as the technical authority for systems and tools within MLZ, influencing Director/VP-level leadership on investment decisions, build-vs-buy trade-offs, and platform strategy through data-driven business cases.
Identify and eliminate operational friction by mapping end-to-end workflows, quantifying inefficiencies, and delivering automation that reduces manual effort and accelerates delivery velocity.
Establish engineering excellence; define standards for system reliability, data quality, observability, and documentation that enable teams to build and operate with confidence at scale.
Force-multiply across the organization by creating reusable frameworks, mechanisms, and best practices that elevate the effectiveness of multiple teams and programs simultaneously.
Drive clarity in highly ambiguous environments where the business strategy, architectural approach, and problem definition may not yet exist. While decomposing complex challenges into actionable execution plans.
Build and maintain strategic partnerships with internal platform teams, data engineering organizations, and tooling providers to ensure MLZ systems integrate seamlessly with the broader AWS infrastructure ecosystem.
Establish metrics, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms to provide stakeholders and senior leadership clear insight into platform health, delivery timelines, adoption, and business impact.

About The Team

*Why AWS*

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

10+ years of program management, tech program management, or related experience
10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
Experience defining roadmap strategy and prioritizing deliverables for your team products
4+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Management, Information Systems, or other related discipline

Experience managing programs across cross-functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working in data centers or critical infrastructure
Experience in automation or monitoring frameworks, deployment or development
Experience performing complex business case analysis to justify technical decisions and presenting the justification to management in a high-level review
Experience communicating and presenting to senior leadership

Experience with AI/ML infrastructure, GPU/accelerator deployments, or high-performance computing environments

Track record of driving technical standardization and process improvement across globally distributed teams

MBA or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.
